text: The purpose of this report is to transmit the draft of the City's Relationship Framework for the Toronto Parking Authority to the Board of the Toronto Parking Authority for information and feedback, in advance of its submission to Executive Committee and Council for approval. The Relationship Framework is City Council's governing instrument used for setting out the specific mandate, delegations of authority, legislative framework, policy directions and accountability for City Boards, and their relationship to the City of Toronto. The Board Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority was previously briefed on Relationship Frameworks in a City Manager's presentation on September 29, 2021.
The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Received the report (May 17, 2022) from the City Manager for information.
